verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's source is published in a public GitHub repository. Community reports say it is licensed as BSD-3 with custom branding clauses added, after an earlier switch from MIT, so the source is readable but under a modified, less permissive license that commenters contest as truly open source. No vendor statement on the license appears in the pack, so this is not a vendor claim contradicted by evidence. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the license terms, a clean OSI-approved license without added branding restrictions, independent confirmation of the current license text.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: the most popular, most full-y featured OSS project
